በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ላቲ: ለ — for her (preposition ለ- with 3fs suffix ላቲ)
ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her')
ወትቤሎ: ይቤ — and she said to him (ወ- + 3fs ትቤ of defective ይቤ + -ሎ '3ms to him')
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
ጠቢብ: ጠቢብ — wise, a wise man (adjective used as noun)
ቤተ: ቤት — house of (noun, construct) · accusative 'a house' (አተወት ቤተ 'she settled in a house') · ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'church' (lit. 'house of Christians')
በፍቅረ: ፍቅር — by love of (በ- + noun, construct 'love of')
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
እምዘ: ዘ — from him who (እም- + relative pronoun)
ሊተ: ሊተ — to me, me (1s pronoun, dative/oblique)
ይደሉ: ደለወ — it is fitting, due (3m sg imperfect, d-l-w)
አነሂ: አነ — I also, I too (1s independent pronoun + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
ኢትትኀየለኒ: ተኀየለ — that you not overpower me (neg. ኢ- + 2ms jussive, tä-stem + -ኒ '1cs me')
ወአነሂ: አነ — and I too (ወ- 'and' + 1s pronoun + enclitic -ሂ 'also, indeed')
ወዐርገ: ዐርገ — and he ascended (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ʿ-r-g)
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
ኀዋኅወ: ኀውኅ — window, door (plural ኀዋኅው, construct 'windows of')
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
ዘይቤሎ: ብህለ — what he said to him (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect ይቤ + -ሎ 'to him')
ለሰሎሞን: ሰሎሞን — Solomon (proper name; ለ- naming the possessor 'Solomon's')
ገብረ: ገብር — servant, slave (noun; accusative predicate in -a, after ኩን) · also the verb ገብረ: he did, made (3ms perfect, g-b-r; ገብረ ሠናየ 'he did good')
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
ወንግሥትኒ: ንግሥት — and the queen too (ወ- + noun, fem. + emphatic -ኒ)
በጥበቡ: ጥበብ — by his wisdom (በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
ዘወሀባ: ወሀበ — which he gave her (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኣ 3fs object suffix)
መጻምአ: መጻምእ — thirst-making, causing thirst (adjective/noun, accusative; from ጸምአ 'be thirsty') (?)
ወየብሰ: የብስ — and dry land (ወ- + noun, accusative of place 'by land') · accusative object 'and dry land' (ወባሕረ ወየብሰ 'sea and dry land', as things made)
ዘርእየት: ርእየ — what she saw (ዘ- relative + 3fs perfect, G)
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, with (preposition) · 'where' as a place conjunction (ኀበ ትነብር 'where she dwells'; ch. 17–19 headings)
ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as, up to (preposition)
ትትነሣእ: ተነሥአ — she will rise (3fs imperfect, tä-stem, 'rise up')
ወሖረት: ሖረ — and she went (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G)
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her')
ቦኑ: ቦ — is there? is it so that? (existential ቦ + interrogative -ኑ)
ተዐድዎ: ተዐደወ — transgressing, overstepping (verbal noun of ተዐደወ; the final -ዎ is the verbal-noun ending, not 'his')
እምነ: እምነ — from (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · from among (እምነ ኴሉ ነጋድያን 'from among all the merchants'; 'apart from' is also possible there) · than, in comparison (ጥበብ ትኄይስ እምነ ኴሉ 'wisdom is better than all')
በታሕተ: ታሕተ — under, beneath (በ- + preposition ታሕተ, construct)
ወአንተሰ: አንተ — and as for you (ወ- + 2ms pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
ንጹሐ: ንጹሕ — clean, pure, innocent (adjective; accusative form)
ኅቡረ: ኅቡር — together (accusative as adverb; from ኅብረ/ኅቡር)
አስተርአዮ: አስተርአየ — it appeared to him (3ms perfect + -ዮ 'to him')
እምሰማያት: ሰማይ — from the heavens (እም- + plural ሰማያት)
ለዓለም: ዓለም — for ever (ለ- 'to, for' + noun 'age, world, eternity')
ወወረደ: ወረደ — and he/it descended (ወ- + 3m sg perfect, w-r-d)
ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
ለእስራኤል: እስራኤል — to Israel, O Israel (ለ- + proper name)
ሎሙ: ለ — to them (preposition ለ- with 3mp suffix: ሎሙ)
ዳግመ: ዳግም — again, a second time (adverb, accusative form in -a)
ወወፅአ: ወፅአ — and he went out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-ṣ-ʾ)
እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
ወ: ወ — and (conjunction, written as a separate word before ይቤሉ)
በደኃሪ: ደኃሪ — in the end, afterward (በ- 'in' + adjective used as noun)
እሖር: ሖረ — that I go (1cs subjunctive, G, ḥ-w-r)
ወቦአ: ቦአ — and he entered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
ወወሀባ: ወሀበ — and he gave her (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኣ '3fs her')
ዘይትፈቀድ: ተፈቀደ — what is needed, required (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect passive of ፈቀደ)
ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
ወብዕለ: ብዕል — and riches, wealth (ወ- + noun, accusative)
ዘየሀይድ: ሀየደ — which dazzles (?) (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G; root and sense uncertain)
ለብሔረ: ብሔር — to the land of (ለ- 'to, for' + construct)
መጠነ: መጠን — measure; መጠነ 'as far as, according to the measure of' (construct as conjunction/preposition)
ዘገብረ: ገብረ — what he did (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, g-b-r)
በከመ: ከመ — according as, just as (በ- + ከመ, conjunction)
ዘወሀቦ: ወሀበ — which he gave him (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object)
